QuestMaker editor font assets, retrieved 2026-10-26

These third-party fonts retain their own licenses, not QuestMaker's license.
Unmodified WOFF2 shards are distributed by ZeoSeven Fonts (cn-font-split).
CSS retains the distributor's copyright metadata. Only local() lookups were
removed so a different locally installed font cannot override these assets.
The application loads a family's CSS only when used, and the browser loads
only Unicode shards needed by displayed text. No text is sent to a font API.
See manifest.json for the exact file list and SHA-256 checksums.

15: Mitimasu / 道须手写体, version 2.00, MASUDA mitiya (增田道也).
MIT. See Mitimasu-LICENSE.txt and original Mitimasu-readme.txt (Shift-JIS
decoded to UTF-8 without changing its content).
https://fonts.zeoseven.com/items/15/
https://blog.masuseki.com/?p=197
https://www.masuseki.com/works/mitimasu.zip

The seven choices use the linked pages' main embedded variants, not every
weight or regional variant. Missing characters fall back to system fonts.

2026-10-28 font choices update:
Visible choices: Isemin (Traditional Chinese label), Minh Nguyen, GenRyuMin2 TC R,
JinzisheZhenhao, KaitouYokokuGothic Heavy. Mitimasu, PixelMplus12,
Tanugo-S-TTF and Kaibunsyo remain bundled for existing documents only;
their original files, checksums and licenses are retained.

1890 (local folder id): KaitouYokokuGothic Heavy / 怪盗予告黑体,
Version 1.001, lavsic. Original font name record 0:
© 2014-2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/), with Reserved Font Name 'Source'.
Original name records 13/14 specify SIL OFL 1.1. See KaitouYokokuGothic-LICENSE.txt.
Requested page: https://www.100font.com/thread-1890.htm
Author page: https://lavsic.booth.pm/items/7920588
Author lists identical font contents in the free and donation versions.
Public unmodified TTF mirror (fixed revision):
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alfianchii/colorless-world/08256d7c2578ded376d7db202b92a388bf681d8b/public/fonts/KaitouYokokuGothic.ttf
Original bytes: 21897756
Original SHA-256: 12899834d3497064f6090462030202efce484f83bfc75ee51e7a12082a80058e
Changes: Unicode subsets generated with fontTools 4.68.0 / Brotli 1.2.1;
WOFF2 conversion, name/license records retained, no glyph design changes.
Common GB2312 characters separated from rare characters for on-demand loading.
License file combines the original font copyright/license notices and the
unchanged OFL 1.1 text; it is not represented as a file shipped by the author.
Retrieved and converted 2026-10-28.
